test_title: RRB Group D Previous Year Paper (Held on: 30 Aug 2022 Shift 3)
subject: general
question: Which of the following languages ​​is spoken by the people of the Union Territories of Dadra and Nagar Haveli and Daman and Diu?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Gujarati**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points:__**

__
 
• In **Dadra **and **Nagar Haveli**, some of the most often spoken languages are **Marathi, Gujarati, **and **Bhili/Bildoli.**
 
• Many areas of **Central India **speak **Bhili**, a language that has Western Indo-Aryan roots.
 
• **Bhilla, Bhagoria, Bhil, Bhilbari, Lengotia, **and **Vil **are other names for the language known as **Bhil**.
 
• The **Devanagari script **is used to write this language of Dadra and Nagar Haveli, which is linked to **Gujarati **and **Rajasthani**. 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information:__**

 
• On the southwest of the nation is **Dadra and Nagar Haveli,** a Union Territory in the Indian Subcontinent.
 
• **Marathi, Gujarati, Bhili, **and **Bildoli** are among the primary languages spoken in Dadra and Nagar Haveli.
 
• With **Gujarat **and **Maharashtra **situated **between Dadra and Nagar Haveli, **it makes sense that these two states would have an **impact **on the **language **spoken there.
 
• The city of Dadra and Nagar Haveli is situated at the base of the **Western Ghats**, and a sizable portion of its area is forested.
 
• These regions are home to a variety of **Tribes**, each of which has its own dialect that can also be referred to as a Dadra and Nagar Haveli language.
